title: ClearMarket Market
description: One row per market per platform. Raw venue data + ClearMarket editorial fill on top. Auto-ingested daily from Kalshi and Polymarket public APIs. API response shape includes the derived field also_on (the same question on other venues), computed at serve time. Thematic grouping across events is handled via tags on the linked event, not via fields on markets.

market_id.description: ClearMarket canonical market ID. Format: 'CM-MKT-' + 6-digit zero-padded sequence. Stable forever — never changes.

platform_market_id.description: Venue's native ID. Kalshi ticker (e.g., 'KXFED-26APR-T3.25') or Polymarket conditionId.

event_id.description: FK to events.event_id. Nullable — editorial assignment. Market can exist without an event.

platform_event_id.description: Platform's own grouping identifier (informational). Kalshi event_ticker; Polymarket event slug.

contract_type.description: Binary YES/NO or true-scalar payout. v0.1 only populates binary; scalar support v0.2+.

contract_multiplier.description: Notional per contract. Usually 1.0 for binaries.

underlying_reference.description: Editorial: specific real-world data reference (e.g., 'BLS Series CUUR0000SA0', 'S&P 500 index close per S&P Dow Jones Indices', 'Credible news reporting — no specific feed'). For multi-outcome events this is COMPOSED per child from the event's generic resolution_reference + this market's group_item_title, so each child names its own subject and no sibling's identity leaks.

group_item_title.description: Per-child subject within a multi-outcome event (the OSI-symbol analog): the candidate, company, strike, or date this market resolves on ('María Corina Machado', 'Discord', '$2 trillion', 'June 2026'). Native from the venue; composes underlying_reference against the event-level resolution_reference.

last_trading_date.description: Last tradeable date. May differ from close_at.

resolution_rules_raw.description: Full rules text from platform. Source for the parsed resolution_triggers.

exclusions.description: What explicitly does not count as resolution.

resolution_risks.description: Known edge cases or dispute scenarios.

arbitration_model.description: Who arbitrates disputes. Stored column (not derived).

resolution_proposer.description: Who can propose resolution outcomes. 'managed_whitelist' captures UMA MOOV2 (Aug 2025 — whitelist of 37 proposers).

resolution_source.description: What data is cited. Editorial fill for Polymarket where API is blank or prose is vague ('consensus of credible reporting').

source_citation.description: Link to the data source itself (not the arbiter's admin page).

resolution_source_list.description: Full source set: every venue-listed source (provenance: platform_api) plus prose-named authorities surfaced by the commitment judgment (provenance: clearmarket_editorial). Added by the source-layer refactor 2026-07-03.

source_commitment.description: Top-level commitment class, stamped at enrichment from the LLM commitment judgment (rubric version recorded in field_provenance). committed_secondhand markets carry 'named' here — the venue DID commit; the quality deficiency is expressed by the subtype and the grade cap.

source_commitment_subtype.description: Full commitment taxonomy (vocabulary: /schema/source-commitment/v1). Feeds the grade ceiling: uncommitted_illustrative caps B; committed_secondhand, uncommitted_placeholder and none cap C.

source_of_record.description: The committed source's name, copied VERBATIM from the venue's text or source list (never minted by the model — the anti-hallucination gate discards untraceable names). The authority for named; the secondhand source for committed_secondhand; null when uncommitted.

source_status.description: THE stamped source judgment — pure function of the LLM commitment classification, stamped at enrichment. Every surface (API/MCP/web/.json/JSON-LD) reads this; none re-derives from raw field presence. Serve layers emit 'unknown' for pre-refactor rows with no stamp and no commitment; the stored value is never 'unknown'.

source_mechanism.description: How multiple sources bind when commitment=named: one controlling authority, a stated precedence/fallback rule, or a quorum (N sources must agree). The CFTC-comment tie-break disclosure, structured.

source_type.description: Objectivity classification of the data source.

threshold.description: Numeric resolution threshold (e.g. 150000 for 'Bitcoin reaches $150,000'). Typed top-level field for cross-venue matching; the verbose parse stays in resolution_triggers. Null for non-numeric (occurrence) markets.

direction.description: Polarity of the claim relative to the threshold. An ATTRIBUTE, not an event discriminator — 'above'/'below' at the same threshold/window/settlement_style are the SAME claim (complementary; comparison normalizes polarity before computing a spread).

settlement_style.description: How the contract settles on the underlying: 'touch' (level ever reached in a window), 'terminal' (level at a single point in time), 'relative' (new high/low), 'occurrence' (a discrete event happens). Distinct from arbitration_model (who arbitrates). Part of the cross-venue event key.

question_id.description: Canonical question id. The normalized real-world question this market settles (subject + threshold + settlement_style, plus window for terminal). Markets sharing a question_id are the SAME question — across venues and across events within a venue. The stable join key CM Signal references. Null where the market has not been canonicalized. (Value prefix is CMX- for historical continuity; it is the ClearMarket question id.)

tags.description: Entity tags for search + cross-cutting retrieval (e.g. 'bitcoin', 'deutsche-bank'). Market-level (events also carry tags). v1 plain strings; later resolved to sameAs Wikidata QIDs.

regulatory_class.description: Regulatory class of the venue. DCM: CFTC-regulated Designated Contract Market. DeFi: token-vote-arbitrated decentralized protocol. Other: anything not in those two buckets (e.g., Manifold, Augur, Zeitgeist, prediction-market projects without CFTC registration or token-vote arbitration).

analyst_notes.description: ClearMarket editorial note surfacing operational edge cases, dispute risks, or time-cutoff details for the market. v0.2: populated via per-venue fallback in render layer. v0.3+: populate via resolution_triggers.resolution_risks in enhance.py.

contract_terms_url.description: Kalshi PDF link to full contract terms. Kalshi-only.

resolution_outcome.description: Once resolved: 'YES', 'NO', or scalar value. Null until resolved.

resolution_value.description: For scalar markets: final numeric value. Null for binary.

first_seen_at.description: When ClearMarket first ingested this market.

also_on.description: DERIVED. The SAME question (same question_id) priced on other venues. Non-null only when this market's question_id has markets on a different venue; null when the question is unique to this venue. Lets a consumer see the cross-venue twin(s) without a second lookup.

venue.description: The other venue this question trades on.

market_id.description: FK to the counterpart market (market_id) on that venue.

price.description: Last price (implied probability) of the counterpart market.

field_provenance.description: Per-field provenance. Keys are field names; values indicate 'platform_api' / 'clearmarket_editorial' / 'derived' / 'null_by_venue_limitation'.
